title: clinopodium multicaule var. taquetii
intro: Clinopodium multicaule var. taquetii, commonly known as Korean mountain mint, is a plant species belonging to the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, with its health benefits including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory problems, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Korean mountain mint include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant effects, which help to soothe the body and relieve symptoms of various ailments. The bioactive constituents of Korean mountain mint include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
